title: December grain arrivals point to a smaller Orvan share

facts.subject: Orvan grain arrivals
facts.statement: Midgard's wheat and maize arrivals from Orvan are well below the levels of a year earlier in December.

source_ref.text_snippet: Preliminary customs figures show Midgard's wheat and maize arrivals from Orvan well below the levels of a year earlier in December.

facts.subject: Orvan port index
facts.statement: The Orvan port index for December is expected to be about 30.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Orvan port index for December is expected to be about 30, according to people who have seen the monthly return.

facts.subject: Orvan's share of Midgard's grain imports
facts.statement: Orvan's share of Midgard's grain imports has fallen.

source_ref.text_snippet: Even so, the direction is clear: Orvan's share of Midgard's grain imports has fallen, while Vanir and rail deliveries have taken part of the gap.

facts.subject: Orvan share in full port return
facts.statement: The full return is expected to show a smaller Orvan share than the provisional customs figures.

source_ref.text_snippet: The full return is expected to show a smaller Orvan share than the provisional customs figures, because it measures loadings rather than arrivals.

facts.subject: Vanir suppliers
facts.statement: Vanir suppliers say they have little spare wheat to offer.

source_ref.text_snippet: Vanir suppliers say they have little spare wheat to offer.
